channel.title: SQP AI News Tracker
channel.description: Daily curated open-source LLM news for SQP developers

item.title: [new-model-release] Qwen 3.8 27B
item.description: Qwen 3.8 27B is now available as an open-weight model release. This is a significant new model that developers can run locally or deploy in production. (via Hacker News, importance 8/10)

item.title: [new-model-release] Welcome Llama 4 Maverick & Scout on Hugging Face
item.description: Llama 4 Maverick and Scout models released on Hugging Face Hub. New Llama generation models available for deployment. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 8/10)

item.title: [new-model-release] SmolLM3: smol, multilingual, long-context reasoner
item.description: SmolLM3 is a small, multilingual, long-context reasoner model. Efficient open-weight model for resource-constrained environments. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 7/10)

item.title: [new-model-release] Gemma 3n fully available in the open-source ecosystem!
item.description: Gemma 3n model is fully available in the open-source ecosystem. Google's lightweight model released for community use. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 7/10)

item.title: [new-model-release] Falcon-H1: A Family of Hybrid-Head Language Models Redefining Efficiency and Performance
item.description: Falcon-H1 is a family of hybrid-head language models for efficiency. Novel architecture for improved performance-efficiency tradeoff. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 7/10)

item.title: [research] A Contract-Grade Verifier for LLM-Generated GPU Kernels
item.description: Research on verifying LLM-generated GPU kernels with formal contracts. Addresses code generation safety and correctness. (via Hacker News, importance 6/10)

item.title: [tooling] dnv2003/v100-skinny — Hand-written NVFP4 W4A16 CUDA kernels and chain-MTP speculative serving — Qwen3.6-27B at up to 366 tok/s on four Tesla V100s, hardware with no FP4 support
item.description: Hand-written NVIDIA FP4 CUDA kernels with chain-MTP speculative serving achieving 366 tok/s on V100 GPUs. Advanced inference optimization for quantized models. (via GitHub trending, importance 6/10)

item.title: [research] Thought-Level Beam Search for Reasoning
item.description: Research on optimizing test-time compute allocation in large reasoning models via beam search at thought level. Relevant to efficient inference in large language models. (via HF daily papers, importance 6/10)

item.title: [research] Maglev: Sliding Recurrent Memory
item.description: Maglev recurrent Transformer with fixed-size sliding memory, parallelizable training. Architectural innovation for efficient sequence modeling. (via HF daily papers, importance 6/10)

item.title: [research] State of Open Models: Summer 2026 Observations
item.description: Analysis of open model landscape trends and observations from mid-2026. Industry report on model ecosystem. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [dataset] NVIDIA Releases 6 Million Multi-Lingual Reasoning Dataset
item.description: NVIDIA releases 6M multilingual reasoning dataset for model training. Large-scale resource for reasoning-focused model development. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [tooling] Accelerate ND-Parallel: A guide to Efficient Multi-GPU Training
item.description: Accelerate ND-Parallel guide covers efficient multi-GPU training strategies. Useful reference for developers optimizing distributed training of LLMs. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [tooling] Vision Language Model Alignment in TRL ⚡️

item.title: [tooling] Accelerate a World of LLMs on Hugging Face with NVIDIA NIM
item.description: NVIDIA NIM integration with Hugging Face for LLM acceleration on Hub. Production inference optimization for open models. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [research] Kimina-Prover: Applying Test-time RL Search on Large Formal Reasoning Models
item.description: Kimina-Prover applies test-time RL search for formal reasoning models. Improves mathematical and logical reasoning in LLMs. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [new-model-release] Welcome the NVIDIA Llama Nemotron Nano VLM to Hugging Face Hub
item.description: NVIDIA Llama Nemotron Nano VLM available on Hugging Face Hub. Efficient vision-language model for edge deployment. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [tooling] Transformers backend integration in SGLang
item.description: SGLang integrates Transformers backend for optimized inference. Faster serving of HuggingFace models with SGLang. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [tooling] Groq on Hugging Face Inference Providers 🔥
item.description: Groq inference provider now available on Hugging Face Inference Endpoints. Fast LLM serving option for production. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [tooling] Introducing Training Cluster as a Service - a new collaboration with NVIDIA
item.description: Training cluster as a service collaboration between Hugging Face and NVIDIA. Managed training infrastructure for LLMs. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [new-model-release] Holo1: New family of GUI automation VLMs powering GUI agent Surfer-H

item.title: [new-model-release] SmolVLA: Efficient Vision-Language-Action Model trained on Lerobot Community Data

item.title: [tooling] 🐯 Liger GRPO meets TRL
item.description: Liger GRPO integration with TRL framework. Group relative policy optimization for efficient RLHF training. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [new-model-release] Falcon-Arabic: A Breakthrough in Arabic Language Models

item.title: [tooling] nanoVLM: The simplest repository to train your VLM in pure PyTorch
item.description: nanoVLM is a minimal PyTorch codebase for training vision-language models. Educational framework for VLM development. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [new-model-release] Falcon-Edge: A series of powerful, universal, fine-tunable 1.58bit language models.

item.title: [research] Vision Language Models (Better, faster, stronger)
item.description: Overview of improvements in vision-language models covering performance, speed, and capability advances. Developers working with multimodal systems will benefit from understanding current VLM landscape. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [dataset] LeRobot Community Datasets: The “ImageNet” of Robotics — When and How?
item.description: LeRobot community datasets initiative positioning robotics datasets as infrastructure similar to ImageNet. Relevant for developers building and training robotics models. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [new-model-release] Welcoming Llama Guard 4 on Hugging Face Hub
item.description: Llama Guard 4 safety model now available on Hugging Face Hub. New model release for content moderation and safety-filtering workflows. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [tooling] Introducing AutoRound: Intel’s Advanced Quantization for LLMs and VLMs
item.description: Intel's AutoRound quantization tool for LLMs and VLMs targeting model compression. Relevant tooling for inference optimization and deployment. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [tooling] Prefill and Decode for Concurrent Requests - Optimizing LLM Performance
item.description: Optimization technique for LLM inference handling concurrent requests via prefill/decode separation. Performance improvement pattern for production deployments. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [research] Introducing HELMET: Holistically Evaluating Long-context Language Models
item.description: HELMET benchmark for evaluating long-context language models. Research benchmark relevant for assessing LLM capabilities on extended sequences. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [new-model-release] Visual Salamandra: Pushing the Boundaries of Multimodal Understanding
item.description: Visual Salamandra multimodal model advancing vision-language understanding. New model release for multimodal tasks. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [fine-tune] Jiunsong/SuperDeepseek-V4-Flash-abliterated-MQ-2xDGX
item.description: Quantized variant of DeepSeek V4 with mixed-precision optimizations and speculative decoding support. Enables efficient local inference of a large model. (via HF trending, importance 5/10)

item.title: [research] How Can Rhetoric Reward-Hack AI Reviewers? Dissecting Rhetorical Sensitivity in AI-Based Peer Review

item.title: [research] Hybrid-Policy Self-Editing for Composable Unstructured Knowledge Editing

item.title: [research] Are You Sure You're Sure? On the Impact of Instruction Tuning on Confidence and Lexical Diversity
item.description: Research on instruction tuning effects on model confidence calibration and output diversity. Examines trade-offs in post-training. (via HF daily papers, importance 5/10)

item.title: [tooling] Jupyter Agents: training LLMs to reason with notebooks
item.description: Training LLMs to reason with Jupyter notebooks for code and analysis tasks. Tooling for agent-based notebook interaction. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 5/10)

item.title: [new-model-release] mmBERT: ModernBERT goes Multilingual
item.description: ModernBERT extended to multilingual capabilities. Advances in efficient embedding model architecture. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 5/10)

item.title: [new-model-release] Welcome EmbeddingGemma, Google's new efficient embedding model
item.description: Google releases EmbeddingGemma, efficient embedding model for semantic similarity tasks. Production-ready embedding tooling. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 5/10)
